entry.title: Phase 1.0.0
entry.summary: First public release of **Phase** (`UID: PHSE`), a CZ-derived 8-voice Phase Distortion synthesizer for Akai MPC OS 3.9.1 and 3.10.1+ (ARMv7 & AArch64), built on Leo Kuroshita's GPL-3 **CrispyZebra** engine. ### Highlights - 8 classic PD waveforms (**Saw**, **Square**, **Pulse**, **Double Sine**, **Saw-Pulse**, **Rez Saw**, **Rez Tri**, **Rez Trap**) with `Wave 1 + Wave 2` cycle alternation on two lines (`Line 1 / Line 2 / 1+2 / 1-2`) - Convex Casio-style DCW curve, exponential 3.6-octave resonan
